coupling_structure_analysis.note: If the phason-photon coupling is modelled by the NAGT-class template (non-flat Berry curvature on E_perp / I_h), the one-loop vacuum polarization has the anti-screening sign, compatible with the GCT bare-versus-observed direction. Template-direction compatibility only.
